summary: arch.yaml defines uart_top, sync2, baud_gen, uart_tx and uart_rx. The top has ports_from_spec true and every spec I/O is wired through. The shared 16x tick feeds both TX and RX. overrun_err is a constant-0 output of uart_rx, which fixes the attempt-1 failure. The single CDC crossing is rx through sync2. PPA numbers are hand estimates; no tool was run in this task and no check is claimed as passed.
assumptions: 'cells' in arch.yaml is taken to mean post-synthesis standard-cell instances excluding fill/tap/decap cells.
Clock-to-Q plus setup overhead is about 0.5 ns.
No calibration data from past synthesis runs exists; all numbers are analytical estimates from typical sky130_fd_sc_hd cell sizes (dfxtp_1 ~20 um2, nand2_1 ~3.75 um2) and rule-of-thumb gate counts.
Power: 50 MHz, 1.8 V, activity of about 10-15% on the counter flops and lower elsewhere. No switching-activity data from simulation is available.
Synchronous reset is implemented as logic in front of D (no sync-reset flop in hd), costing about 1 gate per flop.
TX divides tick16 by 16 with an internal counter; RX uses the same tick16 for oversampling.
The PPA estimate (about 420 cells, 9 logic levels, 35% slack) is a hand estimate, not tool output. It assumes a 16-bit counter/compare and small FSMs at 20 ns in sky130_fd_sc_hd.
Top-level port names and widths come directly from spec.yaml.
Top-level ports are referenced in connections as uart_top.<port>.
Typical corner (tt, 1.8 V, 25 C) is used for timing, matching REQ-005; per-level delay of 0.1-0.25 ns including wire load.
baud_div 0 is clamped to 1 inside baud_gen.
baud_gen is a 16-bit counter with a clamp on baud_div==0 and reload when baud_div changes.
kind assignment: control means FSM-dominant, datapath means counter/arithmetic, interface means synchronizer or top wiring.
parity_mode 3 is folded to none inside both uart_tx and uart_rx.
open_issues: Open spec questions remain: register bus not required (assumed), and framing-error frames still assert rx_valid (assumed yes).
PPA numbers should be confirmed by a Yosys sketch synthesis when tools are available.
Power was not estimated in arch.yaml; no power target exists in spec. A human should confirm whether a power budget is required.

REQ-023 hang-freedom with baud_div changes needs the counter to reload when count > baud_div. A 16-bit magnitude comparator adds roughly 8-12 levels; a down-counter with reload-on-zero avoids this but needs a changed-baud_div detect (16 more flops) or a different scheme. This could break the depth-9 budget and add about 40-60 cells; the architect should decide.
The arch FSM descriptions give a 4-bit tick counter in both TX and RX; confirm RX needs the extra majority-sample registers (3 samples) counted in my estimate.
arch.yaml gives no breakdown behind cells=420; request the per-module split so it can be calibrated after first synthesis.

baud_gen max_logic_depth=9 may be optimistic if the 16-bit equality compare and baud_div==0 clamp are done combinationally in the same path; a registered compare or down-counter reload on zero keeps depth low. Suggest the RTL agent use a down-counter with zero detect.
overrun_err is constant 0 per REQ-022; the reviewer may remove it at G1.
slack_margin_pct=35 has no stated basis. My estimate suggests slack is much higher (about 75-85%), so the figure is conservative, but it should be reconciled after STA.
spec flags PDK/library choice as DEFAULT needing G1 review; the estimates assume sky130_fd_sc_hd.

messages.summary: The arch.yaml PPA estimate (420 cells, 9 levels, 35% slack) is plausible but not verified. My bottom-up estimate is about 330-520 cells (central ~420) for the sky130_fd_sc_hd netlist, so the number is consistent. Logic depth is the weaker point: the 16-bit baud counter compare/reload and the 16-bit baud_div==0 clamp are likely deeper than 9 levels if implemented naively, and the stated 35% slack is unsupported. Sky130 hd typical gate delay is about 0.1-0.25 ns per level with fanout, so 9 levels is roughly 2-3 ns of logic against a 20 ns period. Slack is therefore likely well above 35% even at 15 levels, so the 50 MHz target is not at risk. No past synthesis results exist, so the error band is wide: cells -25%/+25%, depth +/-4 levels, power order-of-magnitude only. Nothing here is a tool result.

self_assessment.reason: The structure is simple and the fix is targeted. Schema validity and the PPA estimates are not verified by tools in this task.
